# alt-text

> Lint and generate image alt text following WCAG 2.2 and the WAI alt decision tree, with HTML scanning and a vision LLM port Python package `trysac-alt-text`, import name `alt_text`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
